dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll help you look.

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Hey there! Have you found my hat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This one?

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: That's it! Oh, thank you so much! Now that I've got my sturdy hat again, I feel so much more at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: It's a special helmet I had someone make for me — it can even block shots from a musket.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're overthinking things. It's just fishing...

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: It might sound crazy, but some time ago, there was a guy fishing right around here when someone shot out his eye. Might've been a musket, might've been a bow. Fishing's a dangerous sport, y'see?

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: I heard tell the whole affair was some sort of power struggle in the Nod-Krai underworld... Who knows the truth? The fact that it happened at all means we should be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, are you here to fish too? Well, if you know fishing, you'll understand the need for a sturdy hat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Why do you need a hat?

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Why? Because a sturdy hat'll keep you safe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you're not wearing a hat...

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: That's why I'm talking to you... You see, the wind blew my hat away.

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you help me find it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you look for it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: If I go looking for my sturdy hat, I'll have to put down my fishing rod. But if I keep holding my rod, I can't go looking for my hat...

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Please, I'm begging you to help.

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Still worried about those ruffians? Don't be. If you do run into them, just tell them my name and they'll leave you alone.

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: But don't go asking me why now. The two of us were destined to meet — you even helped me get my hat back. Just think of it as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Rantiy
dialogues.text: Sorry, I have to go.
